summary: Satisfying Community is a main objective and there is no Communal Plaza, so Community comes from Newspapers: a Paper Mill and a Press. Add a Fitness Park and four Winter Cabins; for the optional 16 Pines, plant Winter Pines with a Foresters' Hub because Lumberjacks fell the existing ten.

build_order.note: 24 Bricks; 1 Paper makes 3 Newspapers; each one read gives Community 6.

pitfalls: Lumberjacks cut the pines the optional objective counts; plant before felling.
The Press needs 24 Bricks, the most expensive step; start the Clay Pit and Brickyard as soon as the Fitness Park is placed.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
